description: A Linux virtual machine (Ubuntu or Debian) with a public IPv4 address. Pick this for a server you can SSH into as root with your own SSH key.
costHint: About $4 to $12 a month, depending on size.

variables.name: name
variables.label: Name
variables.description: Hostname: starts with a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 54 characters. A short suffix from the request is added to it.

variables.name: region
variables.label: Region
variables.description: Datacenter: nyc3 (New York), sfo3 (San Francisco), ams3 (Amsterdam), lon1 (London), fra1 (Frankfurt) or sgp1 (Singapore).

variables.name: size
variables.label: Size
variables.description: s-1vcpu-512mb-10gb (1 vCPU, 512 MB RAM, 10 GB disk, $4/month), s-1vcpu-1gb (1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 25 GB disk, $6/month) or s-1vcpu-2gb (1 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, 50 GB disk, $12/month).

variables.name: image
variables.label: Image
variables.description: Operating system: ubuntu-24-04-x64 (Ubuntu 24.04 LTS), ubuntu-26-04-x64 (Ubuntu 26.04 LTS), ubuntu-22-04-x64 (Ubuntu 22.04 LTS) or debian-13-x64 (Debian 13).

variables.name: ssh_public_key
variables.label: SSH public key
variables.description: The user's SSH public key, one line as in ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub: 'ssh-ed25519 AAAA... comment' (ssh-rsa and ecdsa-sha2-nistp256/384/521 also work). It is installed for root and password login is off. Never ask for a private key.

outputs.name: ipv4_address
outputs.description: Public IPv4 address. Log in with: ssh root@<address>.

outputs.name: tags
outputs.description: Tags on the droplet: the provisioner's resource-provisioner, rp-<requestId> and rp-owner-<user> tags.
